title: Multi-creator video selling the Ivy device

segments.text: Got a bit of an idea that's interesting for a video, which is to sell the Ivy product itself. It's to get several creators and have them talking to the device with the hook being that the ideas are connected into
something like Mr. Beast's viral video that I was watching the other day on YouTube,

The video should be pretty short. I'm thinking that we have it in different hands and different people, and that the goal of the video is to make the product, then the AI, and then the output, and then a video all really seamless, all really fun.

And I think fun is the is the goal, is to make the UI and the AI really personable and really, I guess, optimistic around great ideas and talkative, and we can kind of show the visuals of that rather than lots of fun.
Like to have your thoughts on it and put together some ideas and storyboards and even some demo concepts.

cards.title: Creators talking to the device
cards.gist: A video selling the Ivy product itself by filming several creators speaking to the device, with the hook that their ideas get connected.

cards.title: Borrow that viral YouTube format
cards.gist: She points to a widely shared YouTube video by a well-known creator as the reference for how the ideas should be connected on screen.
cards.their_idea: A viral YouTube video that links multiple people or ideas together in one fast format.
cards.her_take: Use that same connected structure as the hook for the Ivy creator video.

cards.title: Short film, many hands, seamless flow
cards.gist: Keep the video short, pass the device between different hands and people, and show product to AI to output to finished video as one seamless, fun flow.

loose_ends.text: Find the viral YouTube video she was watching the other day.

requests.text: Give thoughts on the video concept and put together ideas, storyboards and demo concepts.
